program_name: Agricultural and Environmental Biotechnology (AEB) — Italian name: Biotecnologie agrarie e ambientali
department: DSA3 — Dipartimento di Scienze Agrarie, Alimentari e Ambientali, Borgo XX Giugno 74, 06121 Perugia
places_available: Not published; a separate visa quota exists for non-EU applicants (PICA reopens if the quota is not reached).
academic_requirements: Requires a BSc in Biotechnology or Agricultural Sciences. Automatic for Italian laurea triennale in Biotecnologie (L-2 / ex class 1) or Scienze Agrarie e Ambientali (Biotecnologie curriculum) at UNIPG. Otherwise at least 80 ECTS across six SSD-group tiers: Maths/Physics/Stats/Informatics 6-12 ECTS; Chemistry 9-20 ECTS; Biology/Botany/Physiology/Zoology/Genetics/Microbiology etc. 20-70 ECTS; Agronomy/Horticulture/Plant protection/Food technology/Animal science 0-20 ECTS; Agricultural economics 0-6 ECTS; Agricultural genetics/microbiology 0-12 ECTS. Assessed by an Admission Committee.
language_requirements: English B2 ("a good command of the English language, at least a B2 level"). No Italian requirement.
entry_exam_or_test: No standardised written test. Requirements and background assessed by an Admission Committee; if the final BSc grade is lower than 99/110 (equivalent to 90/100, GPA 3.6) the candidate is interviewed. Italian regulation equivalent: personal preparation is presumed proven for a laurea grade above 99/110 or a career average of at least 27/30.
nulla_osta_required: Yes — M1234 is on UNIPG's online nulla-osta list (via SOL, from 3 Aug 2026).
required_documents: Bachelor's degree in Agricultural sciences with background in genetics, microbiology, biochemistry, molecular biology
application_deadline_eu: EU/legally-residing applicants: PICA pre-enrolment from 1 July 2026 (no published closing date); SOL enrolment for open-access master closes 1 March 2027.
application_deadline_non_eu: Non-EU visa applicants: current university-wide route is PICA call 2026-visa-03, open 29 May–7 June 2026, 12:00 — CLOSED as of research date (2026-09-05). NOTE: the department's own 'How to apply' page (last updated 16 March 2026) still cites an outdated call, 2026-visa-01, with a 31 March 2026 deadline and a reopening clause if the quota is not filled — this conflicts with the central page and should be verified directly with the department (segr-didattica.agraria@unipg.it) before publishing.
tuition_range: €150–2,200/year depending on family income/merit. Flat Tax (4 UNDP-2016-index brackets) for family-abroad students, or ISEEU Parificato via an affiliated CAF. Declaration window 3 Aug–20 Oct 2026 (late fee to 1 Mar 2027).
cimea_requirement: Not specified at programme level; see university-wide study-documents page for CIMEA/blackout-date rules.
double_degree: YES — double degree with MATE University, Gödöllő, Hungary (Hungarian University of Agriculture and Life Sciences).

source_quotes.quote: The requirements and the specific background of the candidate will be assessed by an Admission Committee. If the final BSc grade is lower than 99/110... the candidate will be interviewed
For the 2026-2027 academic year, pre-registration for international students who require a visa and reside abroad must be completed... no later than March 31st, 2026
Shouldn't the quota for the degree programme is not reached, the procedure on PICA will be reopened
(Double degree with MATE University of Gödöllő, Hungary)

uncertainty_notes: Department 'How to apply' page (2026-visa-01, 31 Mar 2026 deadline) conflicts with the central UNIPG international-students page (2026-visa-03, 29 May–7 June 2026) — both recorded; recommend confirming the currently-valid call directly with the department before publishing a single deadline. Regulation PDF (Reg_AEB_english_25_26.pdf) returned 404 during research; some older dsa3.unipg.it/en/aeb/* URLs are dead after a site restructure — content corroborated via the live HTML pages listed above. Data collected 2026-09-05, all sources unipg.it/*.unipg.it only.
